Class HunterCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.cards.CharacterCard
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.cards.characters.HunterCard
public class HunterCard extends CharacterCard
Concrete CharacterCard representing the Hunter archetype. When a Hunter card sporting the food symbol is collected, the player gains one food per Hunter already present in their tribe.

  • Method Details

    • onAddedToTribe

      public void onAddedToTribe(Game game, Player player)
      Hook invoked after the character has been added to the player's tribe. Default implementation is a no-op; subclasses can override to react.

      If the card has the food symbol, awards one food per Hunter already present in the player's tribe.

      Overrides:
      onAddedToTribe in class CharacterCard
      Parameters:
      game - the game instance
      player - the player who collected the card
